title: Dynamics 365 Sales: sales skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, billing and documented controls are supported, and all cited pages opened successfully despite the earlier rate-limit findings. Minor corrections should complete three admin paths and explicitly report Microsoft's differing descriptions of Sales plugin enablement and its access toggle.
